full_prompt_en: A square, highly detailed portrait illustration shows a bearded man from the chest up, turned slightly left but looking toward the viewer from under a broad brim. His face is modeled in warm copper-brown light with deep shadow over the eyes and at the left cheek. A black mustache and pointed goatee frame the mouth and chin. A large brown hat stretches almost the full width of the image. Its crown carries carved-looking scrollwork, a bright geometric emblem near the left of center, and a small sculpted face near the upper right. The brim casts a strong horizontal shadow across the forehead and eyes. A long silver cross earring hangs from his visible ear, catching a narrow line of light against the dark neck. His brown coat has a raised collar, layered lapels, and fine embossed floral patterning along the shoulder; a gray scarf sits in the neck opening. Behind him, the entire background is filled with tightly interlocking ocher-brown curls, rosettes, and engraved swirls. Their low-relief effect nearly merges with the hat decoration but remains flatter and slightly darker. The composition stays close and frontal, with the face and earring as the clearest focal elements amid dense ornament. Warm directional light gives the cheek, nose, metal pendant, and raised textures small highlights, while the eye sockets and brim remain very dark. The palette is almost entirely sepia, umber, bronze, and black, making texture and value contrast carry the visual energy. The overall effect is dramatic, tactile, and ceremonial.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形、细节密集的肖像插画呈现一位蓄须男子的胸部以上形象，身体略向左转，却从宽帽檐下望向观者。面容由暖铜褐色光塑形，眼部和左颊沉入深影。黑色八字胡与尖山羊胡围住嘴唇和下巴。一顶大棕色帽子几乎横跨画面全宽。帽冠布满雕刻般的卷草纹，中央偏左有一枚明亮几何徽记，右上附近还有一张小小雕塑面孔。帽檐在额头和眼睛上投下强烈水平阴影。可见耳边垂着一枚银色长十字耳坠，在深色颈旁接到一道细光。他的棕色外套有立领、层叠翻襟和肩部精细压花般植物纹；领口里露出灰色围巾。身后整个背景填满紧扣的赭褐色卷曲纹、花盘和刻纹漩涡。浮雕感几乎与帽饰连成一体，但背景更平、更暗。构图贴近而正面，脸与耳坠成为密集纹饰中最明确的焦点。暖色定向光给脸颊、鼻子、金属吊饰和隆起纹样留下小高光，眼窝与帽檐则保持很深的黑。配色几乎全由棕褐、赭褐、古铜和黑色构成，让肌理及明度反差承担视觉能量。整体效果戏剧化、有触感，也有仪式感。
style_prompt_en: A densely ornamented digital-painting surface works within a narrow sepia range of umber, bronze, ocher, and near-black. One softly modeled central volume emerges from a background packed with low-relief curls and repeated carved-looking motifs. Fine contour lines, embossing-like highlights, and tiny shadow channels make the texture tactile. A broad horizontal dark sweep cuts across the upper focal zone, creating a dramatic shadow band. Small bright metal-like accents and a few crisp geometric marks break the otherwise warm, continuous pattern. Directional warm light catches raised edges and one side of the central form, while recessed areas remain dark. The close crop, limited palette, and near-unbroken ornamental density produce a solemn, concentrated composition whose depth comes from value and relief rather than broad color separation.
style_prompt_zh: 密集装饰性的数字绘画表面使用狭窄的棕褐、古铜、赭色和近黑色阶。中央柔和塑形的体量从塞满浅浮雕般卷曲纹与重复刻饰的背景中浮起。细轮廓线、压花似的高光和微小阴影沟槽让肌理可触。宽阔水平深色扫形切过上部焦点区，形成戏剧性的影带。少量明亮金属感重音与清晰几何笔形打破其余连续的暖色纹样。暖色定向光接住隆起边缘及中央形体一侧，凹陷处维持深暗。紧密裁切、有限配色和几乎不断开的装饰密度产生庄重而集中的构图；纵深来自明度与浮雕感，而非宽阔颜色分隔。
theme_en: A bearded man in an ornate broad-brimmed hat
theme_zh: 戴繁纹宽檐帽的蓄须男子肖像
name: Chicano art
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
